data.name: RichTextBox1.Text
data.value: String Comparison: • Compares Unicode values character-by-character. • "Mary" > "Mark" ('y' > 'k'). Testing for Empty Input: • String.Empty / "" has Length = 0. • Use .Trim() = String.Empty to check blanks. IsNumeric() Function: • Returns True if input evaluates as a valid number. Case Conversion: • .ToUpper() / .ToLower() creates a modified copy. • Original string remains unchanged. Trimming Spaces: • .TrimStart() / .TrimEnd(): Removes outer spaces. • .Trim(): Removes both leading and trailing spaces.
